Kimberly / Sara — legal has reviewed the Order Form. We can accommodate Acme's request with the following clarifications & constraints: 

1) Additional insured: We will issue an Additional Insured endorsement limited to the scope of services and the Order Form only. It will be on a primary/non-contributory basis limited to vicarious liability arising from Redwood's performance; we cannot broaden to cover Acme's independent negligence. Endorsement will mirror CG 20 10 language where available.

2) Limits: Redwood is prepared to provide the following for this commercial orderform:
   - Commercial General Liability: $1,000,000 / $2,000,000
   - Professional Liability (E&O): $2,000,000
   - Cyber Liability: $1,000,000 (retroactive date can be provided but subject to carrier confirmation)

3) Waiver of Subrogation: Not permitted as a blanket term. We can request a waiver for property damage claims where carrier allows, but this is carrier-specific and may take extra time.

4) Retroactive date & discovery: For Cyber, we'll provide a retroactive date if the carrier confirms there is no exclusion; Neha, please loop in broker and confirm asap.

I've attached a sample COI and a draft endorsement stub for Acme to review. Please confirm acceptance or flag any carveouts in writing. Once Acme confirms, Neha will coordinate final COI/endorsement issuance with our broker and push to Sara's team.

Thanks,
